target.title: fix(qa-lab): close transport before gateway teardown
target.body:
Closes #106005

## What Problem This Solves

QA Smoke scenarios can finish successfully while Crabline transport work is still delivering an HTTP response. The suite stopped the gateway first, so that in-flight delivery became an unhandled `HTTP response closed before delivery completed` rejection.

## Why This Change Was Made

Close the transport before stopping the gateway. Transport cleanup drains its outstanding provider HTTP work while the gateway can still accept delivery. The cleanup-order regression test preserves that ordering even when cleanup reports an error.

## User Impact

QA Smoke no longer reports a post-success unhandled rejection caused by its own teardown order. Runtime behavior outside QA Lab is unchanged.

## Evidence

- Focused QA extension suite: `29 passed` with `node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-qa.config.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/suite.test.ts` after rebasing onto `2ecd485cd5`.
- LOC guard passed with `node --import tsx scripts/check-ts-max-loc.ts --max 500 --base-ref origin/main`.
- Formatting passed with `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/qa-lab/src/suite.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/suite.test.ts`.
- Fresh autoreview found no in-scope actionable findings.
- Current main's `d9623bd46f` owns the previously failing Crabline fixture/type-contract update; this PR intentionally contains only teardown ordering and its regression test.

## Limitations

The new PR CI run is the remaining broad gate. The branch does not modify the LOC baseline: current main's source-size repair made the earlier rollover unnecessary.
